column1: Seven deviations. Each pauses the stage clock and never the prescription clock, goes to a named handler, and returns the case or re-routes it.

column3: A complaint is logged, or the customer disputes the balance or the security
column4: R-UNI-04 complaint raised; R-UNI-09 debt disputed; screening agent at case entry; any officer
column5: The stage clock; contact with the customer; recovery action on the disputed amount
column6: The prescription clock and every legal period clock
column9: The same decision resumes when the complaint is resolved (R-DEV-09, R-DEV-18)

column4: R-UNI-06 vulnerability identified; screening agent; any officer
column5: The stage clock; collection contact outside the vulnerable customer treatment rules
column9: Routed to the restructure assessment (R-DEV-10), then the route decision (R-DEV-19)

column3: A death is confirmed from the registry or a document
column5: All contact with the customer; every route action
column6: The prescription clock; the estate claim deadline
column7: Hardship and vulnerability specialist, with Legal for the estate claim
column9: Closed if insurance clears the balance (R-DEV-11); otherwise back to the route decision against the estate (R-DEV-12)

column3: Aric or an officer flags fraud
column5: The case and every route action
column9: Fraud confirmed: to write-off with recovery under the fraud case (R-DEV-13). Not confirmed: back to the route decision (R-DEV-14)

column3: A bankruptcy filing or a seizure by another creditor is notified
column5: Enforcement and every collection action against the debtor
column6: The prescription clock; the claim deadline with the official receiver or the Legal Execution Department
column9: Claim filed, then litigation and write-off after the receiver reports (R-DEV-15)

column3: No contact point reaches the customer
column4: Screening agent; failed contact attempts; returned notices
column6: The prescription clock; statutory notices to the last known address
column7: Case owner, with the agent tracing within policy
column9: Contact restored: back to the paused state (R-DEV-16, R-UNI-12). Trace exhausted: escalation or the route decision (R-DEV-17)

column3: The collateral is damaged, destroyed, seized or lost
column4: Screening agent; insurer or valuer report; any officer
column5: The stage clock; disposal of the collateral
column6: The prescription clock; the insurance claim deadline
column7: Case owner, with the agent within policy; a person approves an insurance claim
